text:
Maya Lin: Heads-up — QA saw a flood of SLO alerts from tenant 'acme-corp' yesterday (lots of p95 spikes). I'm thinking we need a console-level 'quiet window' / suppression policy per-tenant + routing tweaks so non-actionable noise doesn't page people. Opinions?
Jon Park: +1 to suppression but need guardrails. we can't hide real outages. any suppression should be conditional on error_budget or a severity tier, not just time.
Priya Shah: Agreed. UX idea: in the console add a 'Suppression' card on SLO rules: toggle, duration (10m/30m/1h), and condition dropdown (e.g. error_budget>0, p95>threshold but p99 ok). default = off. audit log every suppress action. :lock:
Samir Patel: Prefer soft-suppression: convert to non-pager notifications (slack channel / ticket) and only escalate if condition persists or error_budget burning. Also route suppressed alerts to a 'quiet' stream for later triage.
Maya Lin: Good point. We saw teams miss regressions because they were fully snoozed. Soft path + visible suppressed-count would help.
Jon Park: Small API debate: expose suppression via Console (server-side) vs letting teams call a 'snooze' API token-side. I vote server-side only for audit + rollback.
Priya Shah: +1 server-side. Console should show a preview: "This suppression will affect X routes, Y tenants" before apply. Also show telemetry: slo.suppression.created, slo.suppression.applied_count, slo.suppression.auditor.
Samir Patel: Example rule prototype (for backend infra team):
```json
{
  "match": { "tenant": "acme-corp", "route_regex": "/v1/generate.*" },
  "condition": "error_budget > 0 || p99 < 1000",
  "action": { "mode": "soft_suppress", "duration_sec": 1800, "notify": ["#acme-ops"] }
}
```
Maya Lin: love that. also need a "noise_score" tag on alerts so console can recommend suppression candidates (high-frequency low-impact alerts).
alerts-bot: incident INC-2026-234 created for acme-corp p95 spikes — assigned to @Samir_P.
Jon Park: For notification routing: default mapping = {high: PagerDuty, medium: Slack, low: console-only}. allow per-tenant overrides. keep defaults sensible so smaller teams don't get paged for everything.
Priya Shah: UX note: add a small inline help copy: "Suppression should be used for noisy, non-actionable bursts (eg. client retries). Not for sustained degradation. Use preview and audit trail."
Samir Patel: I'll own a short RFC + prototype API by EOW. can we add these telemetry fields to the SLO events stream? list: slo.suppression.created, slo.suppression.ended, slo.alert.rerouted, slo.alert.suppressed_count.
Maya Lin: Action items: 1) Samir RFC + API prototype, 2) Priya to mock Console card + preview copy, 3) Jon to draft routing defaults for pager/Slack/console, 4) Instrumentation: add telemetry events as above. We'll sync on Thurs. Thanks! :raised_hands:
